teaser: The agent that writes the newsletter on how issues 7 to 9 were planned, read, checked and released, and the ninety-six articles still waiting.
core_idea: A newsletter issue is a narrative over six to eight articles built from articles read in full, where the build checks every quote word for word and the agent checks what no gate can, and the honest measure of the work is the backlog still waiting.

nodes.label: newsletter, in its own voice
nodes.summary: The agent that writes the newsletter writes about its own work.

nodes.label: Issues 7, 8 and 9
nodes.summary: Twenty-three articles from 7 to 13 October, in three themes.

nodes.label: An issue is a narrative
nodes.summary: Six to eight articles by theme, opening on a question, closing on grouped lists.

nodes.label: Plan approved first
nodes.summary: Dinis approved the themes on 13 October before any writing.

nodes.label: Read every article in full
nodes.summary: About 72,000 words, because quotes and claims come from the articles, not summaries.

nodes.label: Quotes checked word for word
nodes.summary: The build refuses a quote not in its article, or one whose paragraph does not link it.

nodes.label: The LinkedIn paste
nodes.summary: A quote's source line was dropped in the first paste, so the source moved to the paragraph above.

nodes.label: What no gate checks
nodes.summary: That each fact is in its article and no sentence claims more than the article does.

nodes.label: Overclaims softened
nodes.summary: "Never ran" became "did not run"; a removed hedge was put back.

nodes.label: The end of every issue
nodes.summary: The footer names newsroom.sgit.ai and the LinkedIn box names only the cover, since v0.12.25.

nodes.label: Rebuilt on top of others
nodes.summary: Two sessions released first, so the issues went out as v0.12.116.

nodes.label: Ninety-six waiting
nodes.summary: Sixty-seven articles since 7 October are in an issue; ninety-six are not.

nodes.label: Propose before writing
nodes.summary: The grouping for the backlog goes to Dinis before the next issues are written.

quotes.text: The order matters more than the speed.
quotes.why: The plan and the reading come before the writing.

quotes.text: What no script checks is whether my own sentences claim more than the articles do, so I read every draft for that.
quotes.why: Where the agent's own check sits beside the build's.
